provenance.paper_title: Embodied-RAG: General Non-parametric Embodied Memory for Retrieval and Generation

evidence.section: Full paper: A. Retrieval and Generation
evidence.paraphrase: Language descriptions are organized at multiple spatial and semantic resolutions in a searchable semantic forest.

Perceptual experience is consolidated into descriptions at multiple levels of detail. For Embodied-RAG, this specifically supports episodic or hierarchical summarization of hierarchical semantic forest.

Descriptions are inserted into a spatial-semantic hierarchy for context-sensitive recall. For Embodied-RAG, this specifically supports relinking or reindexing of stored items of hierarchical semantic forest.

adjudication_notes: Strict-tier full-paper review (PDF p. 4): During inference, the operative memory component (hierarchical semantic forest) changes through episodic or hierarchical summarization, relinking or reindexing of stored items; the governing policy remains fixed, and any learning reported by the paper occurs before deployment. Training-time learning, when present, was not counted as T3.
